g.title: iNPH_QSP
g.text: Idiopathic Normal Pressure Hydrocephalus (iNPH) — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
CSF secretion → outflow resistance → craniospinal compliance →
transmantle gradient → periventricular white matter → Hakim triad
Interventions act at three separable points: secretion (acetazolamide · loop diuretics), resistance (shunt valve · ETV), clearance (sleep · glymphatic)
Mean ICP is normal by definition; the pathogenic variables are RESISTANCE, COMPLIANCE and PULSATILITY

g.title: cluster_secretion
g.text: If ≈ 0.35 mL/min ≈ 504 mL/day · the numerator of every pressure in this model

g.title: cluster_circulation
g.text: 2 · CSF CIRCULATION & ABSORPTION — the site of the lesion
Rout normal < 13 · iNPH 15–25 mmHg/(mL/min) — the primary abnormality

g.title: cluster_pulse
g.text: 5 · CEREBROVASCULAR PULSATILITY — the energy that drives the mantle

g.title: cluster_wm
g.text: 7 · PERIVENTRICULAR WHITE MATTER — the tissue that produces the symptoms
two pools: a RECOVERABLE functional deficit and an IRREVERSIBLE axonal loss

g.title: cluster_fibrosis
g.text: 3 · GENESIS OF THE RESISTANCE — arachnoid & perivascular fibrosis

g.title: cluster_biomech
g.text: ICP = Pss + If·Rout (Davson) · C = 1/(E1·(P−P₀)) (Marmarou) · AMP = ΔV

g.title: cluster_ad
g.text: 9 · AMYLOID / TAU COMORBIDITY — and the CSF dilution artefact
c = J(brain→CSF) / [(If+Qsh)/Vcsf + kdeg] — in iNPH BOTH terms fall, so Aβ42 AND p-tau read low

g.title: cluster_triad
g.text: three different tracts, three different time constants, one lesion

g.title: cluster_dx
g.text: 11 · DIAGNOSTIC PERTURBATIONS — each is a step input with its own duration

g.title: cluster_shunt
g.text: 12 · SHUNT HARDWARE — a pressure-controlled resistor in parallel
Qsh = (ICP + h − Popen − Pdist)/Rsh · because Rsh << Rout the VALVE sets the pressure

g.title: cluster_hydrostat
g.text: 13 · HYDROSTATICS — the term no biology in this model touches

g.title: cluster_acz
g.text: 15 · ACETAZOLAMIDE — PK with saturable red-cell binding, PD with a hard ceiling

g.title: cluster_etv
g.text: 17 · ETV — the intervention with no hydrostatic column, and no benefit here

g.title: cluster_ddx
g.text: 18 · MIMICS — what the triad is not

g.text: 19 · MODEL STRUCTURE — 44 ODE states + 1 closed-form fast state
